questions.question: Born on this day in 1947, Bob Weir was a founding member, guitarist, and vocalist of which famous American rock band?
questions.explanation: Bob Weir helped form the Grateful Dead and remained a core member throughout the band's career until they disbanded in 1995.
questions.context:
On this day in 1947: Bob Weir, American singer-songwriter and guitarist (died 2026)
Bob Weir (American musician (1947–2026)): Robert Hall Weir was an American musician and songwriter best known as a founding member of the Grateful Dead. After the group disbanded in 1995, he performed with the Other Ones, later known as the Dead, together with other former members of the Grateful Dead.

questions.question: Which video game publisher created the franchise that served as the basis for the 2026 martial arts comedy film Street Fighter?
questions.explanation: The 2026 movie directed by Kitao Sakurai is the third live-action film adaptation of Capcom's Street Fighter games.
questions.context: Street Fighter (2026 film) (2026 film by Kitao Sakurai): Street Fighter is a 2026 martial arts comedy film directed by Kitao Sakurai and written by Sakurai and T. J. Fixman, with a story by Dalan Musson and Gary Dauberman. It is the third live-action feature-length film based on the Street Fighter video game series by Capcom.

questions.question: What health technology company did Elizabeth Holmes establish in 2003 before being convicted of fraud?
questions.explanation: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing firm Theranos, which collapsed following revelations of fraudulent claims.
questions.context: Elizabeth Holmes (American businesswoman (born 1984)): Elizabeth Anne Holmes is an American businesswoman convicted of fraud in connection with her health technology company Theranos. Holmes founded Theranos in 2003, and its valuation soared in the early 2010s after it claimed to have revolutionized blood testing by developing methods that needed only very small volumes of blood, such as from a fingerprick.

questions.question: Which Friday the 13th character is portrayed by Linda Cardellini as the central lead in the prequel television series Crystal Lake?
questions.explanation: Cardellini plays Pamela Voorhees in Crystal Lake, a prequel series exploring events before the 1980 film.
questions.context: Crystal Lake (TV series) (2026 American slasher series): Crystal Lake is a American slasher television series developed by Brad Caleb Kane that is based on the Friday the 13th film franchise. It is a prequel to the 1980 film and stars Linda Cardellini in the leading role of Pamela Voorhees, with Callum Vinson as a young Jason Voorhees, William Catlett, Devin Kessler, Cameron Scoggins and Gwendolyn Sundstrom.

questions.question: In which US state can the unincorporated community of Neatsville be found in Adair County?
questions.explanation: Neatsville is located in Adair County within the state of Kentucky at the junction of routes 206 and 76.
questions.context: Neatsville, Kentucky (Unincorporated community in Kentucky, US): Neatsville is an unincorporated community in Adair County, located in the U.S. state of Kentucky. It is located at the junction of Kentucky Route 206 and Kentucky Route 76. Its elevation is 705 feet (215 m). For unknown reasons, the town's name was spelled as Neetsville from 1876 until 1886, when the town's post office closed. In its early history from around the 1810s to 1900, Neatsville progressively grew to become a well-established, incorporated town.
